access_method: Public map data and documented APIs
geographic_coverage: Mapped features in the target catchment
limitations: Rural business and facility mapping may be incomplete.
Absence from the dataset does not prove real-world absence.

dataset_name: OpenStreetMap live feature queries via Overpass API
geographic_coverage: Mapped administrative boundaries and commercial features in the requested block
limitations: Mapped features are not a complete census of businesses.
Administrative block availability and tagging vary by location.
Public API capacity and usage policies apply.

provider_name: Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India
access_method: Exact district resource page on data.gov.in and directly hosted Census CSV
geographic_coverage: Rural villages in 631 district resources; aggregated by CD Block Name
limitations: The catalog exposes no consumable nationwide row API and requires district-resource resolution.
The source is Census 2011 and excludes statutory-town residents from the rural village aggregate.
CD-block names and boundaries may not match current OpenStreetMap administrative boundaries.

provider_name: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset_name: HCES 2023-24 State/UT Average Monthly Per Capita Consumption Expenditure
access_method: Reviewed official table versioned in the application; cross-checked with the MoSPI HCES fact sheet
limitations: data.gov.in marks Sourced Webservices/APIs as NA for this resource.
State rural MPCE is a consumption-expenditure proxy, not a direct purchasing-power index or block estimate.
The reference period is 2023-24 and does not measure current local willingness to pay.

provider_name: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation
access_method: Official Government of India public publication; manually curated rule review
geographic_coverage: India; applications are routed through authorized channelizing agencies
limitations: Published terms apply only after NSFDC target-group, income, activity and agency verification.
The publication is not a loan-calculator API or a sanction decision.

provider_name: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
access_method: Official Government of India public publication; manually curated rule review
limitations: The source publishes category limits but not one borrower interest rate or tenure across participating lenders.
A category match does not constitute lender approval.
update_frequency: As updated by the Department of Financial Services

access_method: Official Government of India public publication; manually curated rule review
limitations: Subsidy requires the applicable project classification, area and beneficiary-group rules, then implementing-agency and bank verification.
Margin money is not represented as an upfront cash payment.

dataset_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises scheme portal
access_method: Official Government of India public publication; manually curated rule review
limitations: Current component availability, ODOP/activity eligibility, food-safety requirements and bank terms must be confirmed before application.
The credit-linked subsidy does not supply a universal loan rate or EMI.

provider_name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
access_method: Official Government of India public publication; manually curated rule review
limitations: Published credit tranches apply only to verified eligible traditional trades and programme conditions.
